title: LangGeShiPingZJC
description: LangGeShiPingZJC syncs accessory attributes from LangGeShiPingAPI to SX-Attribute, granting 30+ combat bonuses when equipped.
body:
LangGeAttribute - Accessory Attribute Linking Plugin
Project Introduction
LangGeAttribute is a Minecraft 1.12.2 Spigot server plugin that automatically synchronizes attribute data calculated by LangGeShiPingAPI (an accessory system) to SX-Attribute (an attribute system), allowing players to gain corresponding combat attributes when wearing accessories.

Core Features
✅ Real-time attribute synchronization: Listens to accessory change events and instantly applies new attribute bonuses

✅ Auto-load mechanism: Automatically reads and applies current accessory attributes when players log in

✅ Full lifecycle management: Automatically clears attributes when players quit to prevent data residue

✅ Supports 30+ attributes: Including attack, defense, critical hit, lifesteal, dodge, block, status effects, and more

Supported Attribute List
Category	Attributes
Basic Attributes	Attack Damage, Defense, Max Health, Movement Speed
Special Attacks	PVP/PVE Damage, Armor Penetration, Lifesteal, Health Regeneration
Critical System	Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Anti-Crit
Defense Mechanisms	Dodge, Block, Reflect, Thorns Resistance
Status Effects	Ignite, Wither, Poison, Blindness, Slowness, Lightning, Bleed
Bonus Attributes	Experience Boost, Drop Rate Multiplier, Health/Defense Percentage Bonus
Dependencies
Required: SX-Attribute 2.0.2+

Required: LangGeShiPingAPI 1.0-SNAPSHOT (must be installed separately)

How to Use
Ensure SX-Attribute and LangGeShiPingAPI are installed on the server

Place LangGeAttribute.jar into the plugins folder

Restart the server

The plugin will automatically load the default configuration (config.yml)
